summary: Reproduced recurring mobile/tablet landscape touch-blocker on Detail autoplay CTA with trusted CDP touch using real Matrix metadata/streams. Backend metadata/streams smoke passed. Root cause evidence shows cast lane overlay intercepting touches in specific landscape geometries.

ui_bugs.issue: In landscape 844x390 and 1024x600, trusted touch at CTA center does not reach button; cast lane captures pointer/click so play never starts.

integration_issues.flow: Home -> Detail (Matrix) -> trusted touch on Autoplay
integration_issues.issue: Without bridge: portrait/tablet landscape navigates to /play, but phone/small-tablet landscape remains on detail due to hit-test interception. With MOCKED modern and legacy native bridges, failing layouts still produce zero bridge calls, confirming blocker occurs before native handoff.

issues: Bottom cast lane visually overlaps hero CTA area, making touch target ambiguous/non-functional.
Mobile CSS still targets .max-w-[60vw] while Detail content class is now .max-w-[68vw], so intended mobile width override is stale.

action_items: Fix Detail responsive stacking/hit-testing so cast lane never overlays CTA hit area in landscape phone/tablet geometries.
Align mobile CSS selector with current Detail content class (68vw), then verify layout spacing and cast lane top boundary across 844x390 and 1024x600.
After fix, rerun same trusted CDP touch recipe and confirm button pointer/click increments plus /play navigation in failing geometries.
Keep bridge tests diagnostic-only: browser MOCKED native calls are not proof of physical Android launch correctness.
critical_code_review_comments: Detail.jsx is 3300+ lines and now mixes playback logic, overlay layout, and cast interactions; split modules to reduce regression risk in geometry/hit-testing.
Regression window evidence: commit b137f7bc changed Detail hero width from max-w-[60vw] to max-w-[68vw], but mobile override in index.css still targets max-w-[60vw] (stale selector).

Cast lane introduced as absolute overlay with zIndex 15 (present from commit a849b083 path history) while main content is z-10; this creates touch interception risk in short-height landscape viewports.
seed_data_creation: No backend seed data created. Only local/session storage e2e profile seeding used for UI access.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Trusted CDP touch evidence is already captured. Failing geometries: 844x390 and 1024x600 (button center hit resolves to cast row/lane; button receives 0 pointer/click). Passing geometries: 390x844 and 1280x800 (button receives pointer/click and routes to /play). Modern + legacy bridge MOCKED runs also fail in same geometries with zero native calls, so root cause is pre-bridge UI hit interception.
rca of the issue: Repro steps: login -> seed profile -> open /title/movie/tt0133093 -> trusted CDP touch at CTA center. In failing landscape viewports, cast lane top moves upward into CTA vertical region (e.g., lane top 122 with button 116-168 at 844x390; lane top 332 with button 335-385 at 1024x600). elementFromPoint at CTA center returns cast lane subtree (H3/cast-row), and tap diagnostics show lane pointer/click increments while button remains zero. Therefore autoplay/play appears 'dead' because touch target is blocked by overlay, not by trailer hover logic and not by native bridge implementation. Mitigation direction: adjust responsive geometry/stacking/pointer behavior so lane cannot occlude CTA hitbox.
